attr.title: Drywater
attr.desc: An Old West survival and creature-taming game. Gather, craft, build a homestead, and tame the horses, bears, elk and cougars that share the valley.
attr.inst:
Buy the game on itch.io: https://rcadden.itch.io/drywater

Download drywater.pck and copy it into the ports/drywater folder.
attr.inst_md:
**Buy** the game on [itch.io](https://rcadden.itch.io/drywater)

**Download** `drywater.pck` and copy it into the `ports/drywater` folder.
